summary: Automate post-release gh-plate tag + GitHub Release (#613): workflow always ensures tag (no force-move) and release notes even when tree unchanged; commits PLATE_CORE_VERSION; plan_gh_plate_sync helper + finalize step visibility.
migration_impact: Release PR merge → plate tag push continues to trigger publish-gh-plate-extension.yml. Thin repo gets matching vX.Y.Z tag + Release when missing. Requires THIN_SHIM_DEPLOY_TOKEN (existing). Not template methodology content.
migration_guidance: 1. Ensure THIN_SHIM_DEPLOY_TOKEN has contents:write on akasper/gh-plate.
2. On each plate tag v*, workflow syncs launcher + VERSION + PLATE_CORE_VERSION, tags, creates gh-plate GitHub Release if missing.
3. Repair: Actions → Publish gh-plate thin shim → workflow_dispatch with version.
4. gh plate release finalize prints the gh-plate sync plan for operators.
agent_notes: Publishing-only workflow (not template_payload). Complements #614 version lock and #599 sync. Closes #613.
